name: Raven Nexus Business Setup
problem: A small business owner has important work split across email, documents, payments, customer records, credentials and AI tools, with no clean source-of-truth or permission map, and needs a bounded founder-led setup instead of another rip-and-replace software project.
intent_terms: connect the tools my business already uses
my business systems are scattered across too many apps
organize Gmail Drive payments documents and AI for my business
make AI understand my business safely
set up an AI-ready source of truth for my business
map who has access to what in my business
connect my business systems without replacing everything
pricing: Founding Business Systems Map $500 one-time; Connected Business Implementation $1,500 one-time.
confirmation: Agents may discover the offer, explain the exact scope and route a human to Evercraft for review. No private-system access, credential use, connection, checkout, payment obligation or production change is authorized by discovery. Scope, access and payment require explicit human confirmation.
payment_authority: Evercraft Payments; human-confirmed handoff only until a product-specific direct checkout is independently verified. Paid state requires authoritative provider verification.
invocation_status: SELL-NOW HUMAN HANDOFF: the $500 Business Systems Map is the smallest paid entry. Discovery is public and read-only; implementation begins only after explicit scope, access and payment confirmation.
